test_case_name: Open desktop search field and perform a search

And then check that the search results are displayed for $search_query

test_case_name: Login as guest on mobile with 'ENTRA COME OSPITE' tab

Type $password into the input field with placeholder 'Password'
Click the 'ENTRA' button to submit the guest login form
And then check that the guest user is logged in or receives an appropriate error message
